proposal.hypothesis: One SIMD group per row with register-held float4 values eliminates threadgroup barriers and shared-memory reductions; exp2 via log2e scaling lowers transcendental cost versus the incumbent.
One 128-thread threadgroup per row with four SIMD reductions and two float4 per thread increases parallelism over one SIMD per row, reducing latency for 256x1024 softmax.
128 threads per row caching two float4 values plus simdgroup reductions replace the 256-thread shared-memory tree and its many barriers, reducing softmax latency.
